content.value: Define direction cosines of a line. If 𝑙, 𝑚, 𝑛 are direction cosines of a line, then prove that $l ^ { 2 } + m ^ { 2 } + n ^ { 2 } = 1$ . Find the direction cosines of the line which is perpendicular to the lines with direction cosines proportional to 1, -2, -2; 0, 2, 1.
